about: Dated 2026-11-22 visual configuration for battery-v2m5-20261121: the 2026-11-04 battery robot with the battery backpack V2 rev M5 (frame, cap, Crazepony 2S 3000 mAh, switch, DFR1202, plugs; guide chapter 12, guide-20261121-battery-m5-v147) in place of the V1.40/V1.41 backpack. Appearance only; physics comes from the mass manifest.

body_override_reasons.head_components: The head shell, camera, microphones, touch board and audio ride with the head; jaw_frame remains separately labelled as jaw piece.
body_override_reasons.backpack_components: Battery backpack V2 rev M5 parts and the A7Z saddle are torso mounted.

part_files_reason: Ankles and feet pinned to the visual-20261104 copies as fitted. saddle_body is the V1.35 saddle on the robot, taken from the 11-04 guide snapshot (the guide now draws the V5 saddle, which was not printed, D-047). The new backpack parts come from the guide as drawn (screwed to the OpenRB box posts).

not_fitted_reason: Saddle lid remains not fitted; right-angle pigtail/splice was not bought or failed. Actual factory camera lead and straight adapter lack a calibrated routed mesh. Dual Lock plate/strip installation is not confirmed by current-state. Charger hardware is removed for this battery-only visual snapshot. 2026-11-22: V5 roof plate not printed (D-047); flight pack parts are a separate payload (flight manifests); the USB-A camera adapter is not fitted (1 m camera cable retained, as in the mass manifest).
